hero.credit: Official U.S. Navy photo BuAer 332720 from the U.S. Navy Naval History and Heritage Command available at Navsource.org
hero.source: New York Navy Yard aerial photo 1 in April 1945
hero.description: Aerial view of the U.S. Navy New York Naval Shipyard on 15 April 1945. There are four aircraft carriers under construction: USS Reprisal (CV-35) in Dry Dock No. 6; USS Coral Sea, later renamed USS Franklin D. Roosevelt (CVB-42) in Dry Dock No. 5; USS Kearsarge (CV-33); USS Oriskany (CV-34) (not visible behind Kearsarge).

gallery.title: File:Accession 65-350-CK Model Depth Charge Projector, MK 6 (7372437396).jpg
gallery.artist: Naval History & Heritage Command from Washington, DC, USA
gallery.description:
Accession: 65-350-CK
Model Depth Charge Projector, MK 6
11" H X  18" W
Brass, Wood
Model is from the collection of New York Naval Shipyard. The MK 6 projector was used to project depth charges to port and starboard  of a vessel  to supplement those fired from the stern.

Collection of  Curator Branch, Naval History and Heritage Command.
